scope: A5 actual three-base railway distribution and saved HUD callbacks

fixture.construction: Fresh main base; two sub bases at (-5,20) and (10,14); three active stations and 33 tracks on a terrain-valid closed route

play.hudConfiguration: A load 100, B unload 30, C unload 40, cargo iron; fuel and start from railway HUD
play.prepareResult: PASS actual three-base HUD configuration, fuel, 100 load/30+40 unload/30 cargo; isolated save and reload requested
play.reloadResult: PASS actual v2 reload preserves three base inventories/route/cargo; saved route, configure, fuel and start button callbacks
play.reloadComparison: Railway snapshot and all three base inventory records equal their saved values; C station context selects the third stop
play.savedButtonCallbacks: Route row, C unload target change, C coal refuel, and start invoked through scene Button.onClick; no duplicate C service on restart

limits: Station and track placement was performed through placement APIs; route configuration used HUD commands and persisted button callbacks.
Physical pointer input, keyboard focus, multiple resolutions and standalone build remain QA-06/07.
ACC-015 and ACC-019 quantities were covered by existing model tests, not repeated in this three-base Play fixture.
